items.title: TALON
items.subtitle: Self-hosted multi-agent AI system
items.summary: Started as an AI job-search pipeline and grew into a self-hosted multi-agent platform: a model gateway, a mixture-of-agents engine and CI/CD, with a human approving every outward action.
bullets: Original pipeline: job APIs, LLM scoring, Gmail OAuth, Telegram alerts, CRM sync, a network graph and daily reporting, shipped in phased releases.
Added a LiteLLM model gateway that routes between local Ollama models and cloud models, a mixture-of-agents engine and a CI/CD pipeline.
Human-in-the-loop by design: it reads and drafts but never sends email or applies to jobs on its own.
Now the base for a multi-agent security research demo in an independent study at IU Indianapolis.

items.title: si_news
items.subtitle: Free tech & AI news aggregator
items.summary: A free site that gathers the latest AI and tech news (frontier labs, chips, international AI) into one fast stream, built at zero hosting cost.
bullets: Deployed on Cloudflare Pages; streams the latest stories with archive pages and flat geometric SVG glyphs instead of photos.
Designed for $0 running cost; AI summaries are planned through a model gateway that prefers local models and falls back to cloud.
Built by looping with Claude Code, then reviewed and directed by hand.

items.title: This portfolio
items.subtitle: A latent space you can fly through
items.summary: Every bright point here is a real project, role, award or skill, placed by its meaning: a Python pipeline embeds each description and UMAP folds the space into 3D.
bullets: Build time: Python embeds every item (sentence-transformers MiniLM), reduces to 3D with UMAP and writes one JSON file.
Run time: Next.js and react-three-fiber draw the cloud with custom GLSL shaders; GSAP ScrollTrigger and Lenis turn scroll into a camera flight.
The search box embeds your query in the browser: instantly with TF-IDF, or with the same MiniLM model that placed the points if you opt in to deep search.
